title.rendered: Feast of St. Martin of Tour

content.rendered:
PROGRAM

Chapel of the Priory of Saint Michel, Vico dietro gli staggi old town (Ventimiglia Alta):

10:30 a.m. Divine Liturgy of Saint Peter in honor of Saint Martin

11:45 a.m. Consecration ceremony of the Oblates of the Order of Mary Magdalene

San Francesco Multipurpose Hall in Ventimiglia, Via Garibaldi, old town (Ventimiglia Alta):

2:30 p.m. Opening of the Grand International Chapter of the OESMC by the Grand Master and his Grand Officers

3:00 p.m. Blessing of the Novices

3:15 p.m. Consecration of the Novices to the 2nd degree of Sergeant-at-Arms

3:45 p.m. Ceremony of Knighthood to the 3rd degree

4:30 p.m.: Opening of the Grand Chapter to the 4th degree of Knight of the Temple

4:45 p.m.: Ceremony of Armament to the 4th degree of Knights (men and women)

5:15 p.m. Opening of the Grand Chapter to the 5th degree of Knight of the Castrum Sepulcri

5:25 p.m.: Reception at the 5th degree of Knights (men and women)

5:45 p.m.: Opening of the Grand Chapter at the 6th degree of Knight devoted to Enoch

6:00 p.m.: Reception at the 6th degree of Knights devoted to Enoch (men and women)

6:45 p.m. Opening of the Grand Chapter at the 7th degree of Knight Priest of the Holy Spirit

7:00 p.m. Consecration at the 7th degree of Knights Priests of the Holy Spirit (men and women)

7:30 p.m.: Closing of the International Grand Chapter by the Grand Master and his Grand Officers

8:00 p.m. Concert by the Abbey Gendarmerie

9:00 p.m. Banquet of the Order of the OESMC

10:30 p.m. Closing of the Banquet with the official cake and auction of a sculpture donated by our beloved Sister and artist Sylvie Santonacci, Dame of the OESMC.
